messages:
Maria Nguyen: quick heads-up: bench scan flagged a long-history regression for vela9b int6 vs int8 on GTN conversational priming. rough hit on recall when history >3k tokens. details: https://bench.internal/vela9b/reg-3276 :mag_right:
Ellen Park: can you drop the topline numbers here so product can triage the impact?
Maria Nguyen: sure — sample n=3k (long-history slice). recall@10: int8=0.815, int6=0.790 (delta -0.025 abs, -3.07% rel). p95 latency: int8=230ms, int6=165ms. cost per 1k toks: int6=$0.16, int8=$0.23.
Samir K.: interesting. is the regression uniform or concentrated by turn-count/history-length?
Maria Nguyen: concentrated when history_tokens>3000 and when the prompt contains multiple entity references — single-turn and short-history look fine.
Jonas L.: hypothesis: quantization noise accumulating in late-attention/KV leads to context degradation. possible mitigations: (1) keep full-precision KV cache for last N layers, (2) dynamic fallback to int8 for requests with large history, (3) hybrid prompt rewriting to reduce tokens.
Maria Nguyen: I'll run a quick ablation for (1) today. repro command:
```
python run_bench.py --model vela9b --quant int6 --slice long-history --kvcache-last-layers 4 --kvcache-precision float16 --seed 42
```
bench-bot: run recorded: run_id=3276, commit=9f2b4c, variants=[int6,int8,int6-kvfloat16-last4]. artifacts at s3://bench/vela9b/3276/. diff report generated.
Ellen Park: product wants cost estimate for a routing fallback if we send ~15% of tokens (long-history) to int8. baseline traffic ~120M tokens/mo.
Maria Nguyen: quick calc: 120M = 120,000 * 1k tokens. if all int6: 120k * $0.16 = $19,200/mo. all int8: 120k * $0.23 = $27,600/mo. 15% int8 routing => int8_tokens=18k, int6_tokens=102k. cost = 102k*$0.16 + 18k*$0.23 = $16,320 + $4,140 = $20,460 -> +$1,260/mo (~6.6% uplift).
Samir K.: recommend a staged holdback: 0.5% -> 2% -> 15%. log recall@10 and business metrics. also add hourly synthetic probes that synthesize 10 long-history sessions.
Jonas L.: operational rule suggestion (proto): `route.if(history_tokens>3000 && multi_turn).dest = vela9b-int8` ; alternate: `route.if(history_tokens>3000).kvcache_precision = float16` (if runtime supports per-request kv precision).
Maria Nguyen: plan: 1) finish kv-last4 FP16 ablation and post diff by EOD. 2) if ablation recovers most of the gap, propose per-request kv-precision change (lower cost than full int8 fallback). 3) else run small canary (2% long-history traffic) to int8 and measure.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-05-03T02:00:00Z -> 2026-05-03T05:00:00Z. canary_id=canary-vela9b-3276. Owner=@Maria Nguyen.
Ellen Park: please create a small dashboard: recall@10 by history_bucket (0-1k,1k-3k,3k+), p50/p95 latency, token burn delta, and a random sample of 50 diffs for manual review.
Maria Nguyen: will do. I'll post the ablation artifacts + dashboard link once ready and we can decide next steps with GTN PMs. :white_check_mark:
